{{Quote|I am transmitting the coordinates of the target. Kill the guardians and bring the boy to me.|Thaum Rystra, ordering Tol Skaros to capture Caeleb and kill the boy's parents|<ref name="Child of Light" />}}
The '''father''' of the [[Youngling/Legends|child]] [[Caeleb]] was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Tol Skaros]] ventured to Dalicron-4 to kidnap Caeleb and [[Death/Legends|slew]] the boy's father while attempting to apprehend the child.

==Biography==
{{Quote|They'll take good care of each other.|Caeleb, to his Rebel rescuers, explaining his request that his mother and father be buried together|<ref name="Child of Light" />}}
The father of the [[Youngling/Legends|child]] [[Caeleb]] was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Though he received no formal training, the man gained a rudimentary use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and acquired a [[Color/Legends|green]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Child of Light" />

The man [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a [[Caeleb's mother|Force-sensitive woman]] and the pair [[Reproduction/Legends|conceived]] a son, Caeleb,<ref name="Child of Light" /> born in about [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> who was the subject of an ancient prophecy heralding the coming of a "Child of Light" possessing unlimited Force potential. The man and his wife sought to bring up Caeleb away from strong Force influences to protect their son from his power. After the man received a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of a large, unusually-colored [[Tree/Legends|tree]] on the sparsely-populated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]] sited on a spot devoid of the Force he instantly knew it to be the perfect place to raise their child. Unknown to the man, the Force bubble had been created almost one thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier by the Jedi Master [[Duumas]] as a haven for the Child of Light. The man and his wife subsequently settled with Caeleb in a homestead sited next to the tree. The two parents raised their son in a happy environment and forbade Caeleb from passing beyond a marker wall that surrounded their home at the boundary of the Force bubble.<ref name="Child of Light" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Dates" /> the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]] dispatched his apprentice, the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Tol Skaros]], to capture Caeleb so that Rystra could exploit the boy's Force talents to resurrect the [[Force ghost/Legends|Sith spirit]] [[Valik Kodank]]. Rystra ordered his apprentice to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Caeleb's guardians when kidnapping the child and Skaros led a force of [[Nek/Legends|nek battle dogs]] and and [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]] in an assault on the family's homestead. Caeleb's father drew his lightsaber and sparred with Skaros while the nek dogs attacked Caeleb's mother. The man's screams woke up their son, who had been [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]] inside the homestead, and as the neks overcame and killed his wife the man was struck by anguish. In his tormented state, the man was slain by Skaros and Caeleb observed his father's death from a window. Just as the man died, a group of agents of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] insurgent group arrived and prevented Skaros from taking Caeleb. At Caeleb's request, the Rebels buried the bodies of the boy's parents under the tree next to their homestead, which the child believed would allow his mother and father to take care of each other in death.<ref name="Child of Light" />

==Personality and traits==
Caeleb's father sought for his son to have exposure only to positive emotions as the boy grew up. The man cared deeply for his wife and child and was greatly distressed by Caeleb's mother's death and by the prospect of what would happen to Caeleb at Skaros' hands.<ref name="Child of Light" />

==Behind the scenes==
The father of the child Caeleb appeared in ''[[Child of Light]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Lee Pickler]] and set within [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity that was published by [[RPGA]] in [[2000]] as the opening instalment of the [[Child of Light saga|''Child of Light'' saga]] roleplaying series. He was later referenced in the second<ref name="Soulsaber">"[[Soulsaber (adventure)|Soulsaber]]"</ref> and third adventures in the series,<ref name="Light and Dark">"[[Light and Dark (adventure)|Light and Dark]]"</ref> [[Soulsaber (adventure)|''Soulsaber'']]<ref name="Soulsaber" /> and [[Light and Dark (adventure)|''Light and Dark'']],<ref name="Light and Dark" /> in [[2001]]<ref name="Soulsaber" /> and [[2002]] respectively.<ref name="Light and Dark" /> In ''Child of Light'', the man's fight with Skaros can take place either within or beyond the Force bubble surrounding the family's home. If they engage in combat outside the bubble Caeleb's father initially gains the upper hand is ultimately beset by feelings of grief for his wife and worry for Caeleb's wellbeing, thereby allowing Skaros to gain an advantage and strike him down.<ref name="Child of Light" /> The man's name is not specified in any of the adventures of the ''Child of Light'' saga.<ref name="Child of Light" /><ref name="Soulsaber" /><ref name="Light and Dark" />
